description: Canadian rental property analysis: cap rate, net operating income, gross rent multiplier, expense ratio, annual cash flow and cash-on-cash return, with the cap rate compared to typical local yields. Mortgage math uses Canadian semi-annual compounding.

annualOperatingExpenses.description: Annual operating expenses in CAD (tax, insurance, management, maintenance, landlord utilities); excludes the mortgage

city.description: City used for the cap-rate benchmark range

downPayment.description: Down payment in CAD. Set equal to purchasePrice for an all-cash purchase.

interestRatePct.description: Mortgage rate as a percent, e.g. 5.49

monthlyGrossRent.description: Gross monthly rent for all units in CAD

vacancyRatePct.description: Vacancy allowance as a percent of gross rent

name: cap_rate
title: Cap Rate & Rental Property Calculator (Canada)
